abstract.p: This document describes an approach to solve the SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Detection, specifically for Track A: Multi-label Emotion Detection and Track C: Crosslingual Emotion Detection. In this document, the method utilizes an ensemble of RoBERTa models, each trained with different hyperparameters to enhance robustness and performance. For Track C, an additional neural machine translation (NMT) approach is added. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of model ensembling and translation preprocessing in tackling the challenges posed by Task 11.
